time_test.why: 13:00 = Indian lunch break; 17:30 = Indian commute + UK lunchtime; 19:30 = Indian prime time (baseline); 21:30 = late Indian evening + UK afternoon. 22 Nov: posts per slot: 13:00 = 4 (Sun 8, Tue 17, Wed 18, Sat 21 Nov), 17:30 = 3 (Mon 9, Thu 19, Fri 20 Nov), 19:30 = 6 (31 Oct-4 Nov, Fri 13 Nov), 21:30 = 4 (Sat 7, Wed 11, Sun 15, Sun 22 Nov). Every slot now has 3+ posts, but there is no per-video data to compare them (0 vidIQ credits until 30 Nov; Metricool data stops at 14 Nov), so the slot can't be locked yet. 19:30's posts are mostly from the comparison era, so this rotation gives it two card-era days (Mon, Fri) and moves every slot onto weekdays it hasn't had: 13:00 Thu/Sun, 17:30 Wed/Sat, 19:30 Mon/Fri, 21:30 Tue. Lock in once per-video stayed rate and 48h views are available for 3+ posts per slot.
time_test.decide_by: views and engaged views in each video's first 48 hours
